name: Elemental Reaction: Lunar-Crystallize
desc: When <color=#FFE14BFF>Geo</color> meets <color=#FFE14BFF>Hydro</color>, and certain other conditions are met, a special <color=#FFE14BFF>Lunar-Crystallize</color> reaction occurs, and three Moondrifts will form near the target.

imgDesc.text:
When
Geo meets
Hydro, and certain other conditions are met, a special
Lunar-Crystallize reaction occurs, and three Moondrifts will form near the target.

Triggering the Lunar-Crystallize reaction three times will initiate Moondrift Harmony, which deals Geo DMG to nearby opponents.
This DMG can trigger CRIT Hits, and the DMG dealt is based on all characters who have applied elements during the reaction.
